about: Regression set for rank() in search.mjs, run by search.test.mjs against this checkout's index/search.json. Each case gives a query and what must appear in the top three. An item with | lists interchangeable listings: one of them is enough. An empty top3 means nothing in the directory answers the need, so rank() must return nothing; vertical then names the vertical the hint should point at, or null when none fits. A case marked pending is a known gap: the test checks that it still fails, so the mark comes off when it is fixed. The plain group is how people describe a need. The products group names a product and must not regress when the plain group improves.
